_meta.starting_location: Firelink Shrine (after reaching the Road of Sacrifices)
_meta.description: Sirris appears at Firelink once the player reaches the Road of Sacrifices region. Her questline proper (Creighton co-op in Irithyll, Hodrick showdown, Sunless Talisman) runs after the Abyss Watchers. The first-third job is purely defensive: do not fail her by ranking up Rosaria's Fingers with Pale Tongues.
_meta.mined_from: FightinCowboy 100% walkthrough eps 10 (first Firelink meeting + Fingers hostility dialogue), 13 (Rosaria respec mechanics) (2026-07-05). Wiki cross-check: as of regulation 1.05 respec/appearance changes do NOT fail her — only offering a Pale Tongue to rank the covenant does.

evaluation.rule: Phases are evaluated top-to-bottom. First matching phase is current. Fallback phase always matches.
evaluation.detection_gaps: No flags for Sirris talks or for 'Pale Tongue offered'. Rosaria's Fingers + Pale Tongue possession define the risk window; the actual offering is undetectable until we label the covenant-rank flag. EMEVD NPC range 1200-1219 needs controlled saves.

sirris_hostile.label: Sirris left Firelink / hostile (quest failed)
sirris_hostile.how_to_confirm: Controlled save pair: offer a Pale Tongue to Rosaria with Sirris met, rest, diff. EMEVD range 1200-1219.

phases.label: Rosaria's Finger — handle Pale Tongues with care
phases.detection_note: Covenant item present. Cannot detect whether a tongue was already offered.
phases.status_message: You joined Rosaria's Fingers. Using Pale Tongues for respec or appearance change is SAFE for Sirris's questline (regulation 1.05+) - but OFFERING a Pale Tongue to rank up the covenant makes Sirris hostile and ends her quest. Save the covenant ranking for after her questline (or a later playthrough).
next_steps: Respec/appearance via Rosaria: safe. 'Offer Pale Tongue' to the covenant: NOT safe until Sirris's quest is done
Sirris's quest continues after the Abyss Watchers - her summon sign appears near the Church of Yorshka in Irithyll

phases.label: Sirris waits at Firelink
phases.detection_note: Area-gated on the Road of Sacrifices region; her arrival needs only area progression.
phases.status_message: Sirris of the Sunless Realms now stands in Firelink Shrine (near the throne stairs). Talk to her when you pass through - and remember: never offer Pale Tongues to Rosaria's covenant while her questline is unfinished.
next_steps: Her first real quest beat comes after the Abyss Watchers (Creighton's invasion in Irithyll) - nothing to do until then except not upsetting her
She is also connected to Hodrick of the Mound-makers - joining the Mound-makers is fine; ranking Rosaria's Fingers is not

phases.label: Not appeared yet
phases.status_message: Sirris has not appeared at Firelink yet. She shows up once you reach the Road of Sacrifices.
next_steps: Progress to the Road of Sacrifices, then check Firelink Shrine

always_check_warnings.label: Pale Tongue + Rosaria's Fingers = questline hazard
always_check_warnings.message: You hold a Pale Tongue and belong to Rosaria's Fingers. Offering the tongue to RANK UP the covenant makes Sirris hostile and permanently fails her questline. Spending it on a respec or appearance change is safe. Hold covenant offerings until Sirris's story is complete.
